• Technical acceptance: 3-day functional test, 2-day performance check (Camila will coordinate test harness).
• Legal & billing: Redwood provides a DocuSign contract with marketplace terms; Helios issues PO against that contract.
• Invoice routing: please send the signed PO to invoices@helioshealth.com and cc marcus.lin@redwood.com — Redwood Finance will raise the invoice to the APAC billing entity once DocuSign completes.
• SOC2 / evidence: we can provide a scoped SOC2 evidence package; attached SOC2-scoping.pdf lists items we can deliver during acceptance.

Proposed milestone dates (example timeline in attachment):
• Kickoff & security review: within 2 business days of this email
• Technical eval window: 2026-10-18 — 2026-10-22
• Legal sign & PO: target 2026-10-19 — 2026-10-23
• Invoice issued: within 5 business days of PO receipt

If Helios has a required invoice template or acceptance checklist, drop it in and we’ll map owners. Camila — I’ll hand the technical plan over to you. Karthik / Marcus — note the request on invoice entity mapping and tax fields.

Neha / Sara — copying the technical plan into the MAP and adding a short test schedule. Quick notes: 

• We’ll provision a private-offer sandbox on GCP with the same GPU profile as production (n1-highmem sim) — estimated provisioning time 24 hours.
• Acceptance criteria (pass/fail):
  - Functional: sample generation correctness on 10 canonical prompts (pass >= 95% fidelity)
  - Performance: p50 latency < 220ms on 16-token completion; p95 < 600ms
  - Throughput: sustained 10 r/s for 30m using batch size = 8
• Data handling: KV cache cleared between test runs; no customer data persisted beyond test window (we’ll provide a short attestation).

Proposed test window: 2026-10-18 — 2026-10-20 (we can compress to 18–19 if Helios needs an earlier legal sign).
